output.summary: The win-rate collapse is mostly a mix and measurement artifact. On 2026-04-15 the MQL threshold fell to 40 and opportunities began to be created automatically. Low-score leads (mostly LeadSpring) then entered the pipeline and closed at 3.3%, with 61% of their losses auto-closed as Unresponsive. Excluding that band, Q3 win rate is 29.4% against 31% in Q1, and non-marketing win rate is flat. Bookings are nearly flat. Rep activity is up, and comp and attrition evidence does not support demotivation. Competitor price cuts do not explain it. Whether LeadSpring's high-score leads are worse is unresolved. Re-baseline reporting and stop auto-creating field opportunities for 40-59 leads. Do not run PIPs. Q1 is the next evidence to collect.
